facts.business: Sri Ramakrishna Mills (Coimbatore) Limited is engaged in textile manufacturing (cotton yarn) and real estate development through joint development agreements.

auditor.name: C S K Prabhu and Co LLP
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualification: Accounting software did not have audit trail (edit log) facility enabled for the year ended March 31, 2026 and March 31, 2025.

key_risks: Accounting software lacks audit trail (edit log) facility as required by statute
Penalties imposed by ROC for non-compliance (CIN not printed in annual report; non-disclosure of related party transactions with JGOM in FY 2016-17)
Dependence on joint development agreement for real estate revenue recognition
Inventory pledged as security for liabilities (Rs 1,195.28 lakh as at 31.03.2026)
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with related parties are in compliance with Sections 177 and 188 of the Companies Act, 2013, and details disclosed in Note No. 53 of financial statements. Penalty imposed for non-disclosure of related party transactions with JGOM in FY 2016-17.
